patterns.note: The site uses a full-width, dark background for its hero and key informational sections, contrasted with full-width light background sections for feature showcases, creating a strong visual rhythm.
A highly decorative, oversized serif typeface is used exclusively for primary headings, creating a bold and artistic statement, while all other text uses a clean, modern sans-serif.
The primary color scheme is high-contrast black and white, with a vibrant, almost neon green used sparingly for calls-to-action and subtle accents, making them pop against the dark backdrop.
The hero section features a dynamic arrangement of floating, interactive image cards that subtly animate around the central headline, creating a sense of depth and engagement.
Key sections are introduced with large, centered, single-line headlines, often followed by a concise paragraph, maintaining a clean and focused presentation.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a canvas-based animation system to render multiple floating, layered image cards that subtly move and interact around the main headline, giving a dynamic and engaging first impression.
The primary headline text in the hero section uses a staggered fade-in or reveal animation on page load, with multiple instances appearing and fading out to emphasize the final, prominent headline.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top of the viewport upon scrolling, ensuring consistent access to site navigation and calls-to-action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, decorative serif headings (~5-6x body) create a strong visual hierarchy, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and subheadings.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to interactive elements like buttons and image cards, maintaining a modern yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around hero elements, contributing to a premium and uncluttered aesthetic.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly decorative, oversized serif typeface for primary headings, combined with a dynamic, canvas-animated hero featuring floating image cards, creates a unique blend of artistic elegance and modern interactivity that immediately captures attention.
